name: Toon Control
note: Pure Toon archetype build (Pegasus's deck theme, built as its own archetype, not the printed Pegasus Starter) — docs/decks-archetypes.md §6. Names validated against cards.cdb.
manual:
**Game plan:** land `Toon World`, then beat down with Toon monsters that make direct attacks whenever the opponent controls no Toons — a fast, evasive clock the opponent can't block by summoning bigger monsters.

**Key cards / engine:** Toon World (the linchpin); Toon Table of Contents (search consistency); direct-attack Toons; Comic Hand theft.

**How to pilot / combo lines:**
- **Find Toon World first, every game.** `Toon World` activates by paying 1000 LP; every Toon is destroyed if Toon World is destroyed. `Toon Table of Contents` adds any Toon card (including itself or Toon World) from Deck to hand — run 3 of each so you almost never brick on the linchpin.
- **The direct-attack clock.** With Toon World up and the opponent controlling no Toons, your Toons attack directly: `Toon Gemini Elf` (1900, discards a random hand card on damage), `Toon Goblin Attack Force` (2300), `Toon Masked Sorcerer` (900 but draws a card on damage) — they swing straight to face and can't be chump-blocked.
- **Big Toons via Toon World.** `Toon Summoned Skull` (2500) needs 1 tribute; `Blue-Eyes Toon Dragon` (3000) / `Manga Ryu-Ran` need 2; `Toon Mermaid` needs none — all pay 500 LP to attack and can hit directly. `Toon Dark Magician` discards a Toon to Special Summon a Toon from Deck or search a Toon Spell/Trap.
- **`Comic Hand` steals a blocker:** while you control Toon World, equip it to an opponent's monster to take control of it as a Toon that can attack directly. `Shadow Toon` burns for a targeted monster's ATK. ⚠ unverified line (general Toon play, not a fetched primer).
- Protect the linchpin: hold `Swords of Revealing Light` and the trap suite to survive the turn Toon World eats an MST, and keep a spare Toon Table of Contents to re-fetch it.

**Weaknesses:** total dependence on Toon World is an obvious target — one Mystical Space Typhoon blows up your whole board; most Toons also can't attack the turn they're summoned, giving the opponent a turn to answer.
